search.placeholder: Search products, customers, suppliers or sections
search.hint: Arrow keys to move, Enter to open, Esc to close
search.type_more: Type at least two letters to search.
search.no_results: Nothing found for “{q}”. Try another word.

auth.hero_title: Sell, restock and decide with your own business data.
auth.hero_text: ImpulsoPYME brings your sales, inventory and suppliers together, and tells you what is about to happen before it does.
auth.point_forecast: Sales forecast for the coming weeks
auth.point_stock: Suggestions on what to order and how much
auth.footer: Made in Pasto for small businesses in Colombia. Supports SDG 8 and 9.
auth.login_text: Use the username and password you registered with.
auth.register_text: Tell us what kind of business you run and we will set up the rest with you.
auth.username_hint: 3 to 30 characters: letters, numbers, dot or underscore.
auth.sample_text: Fills the app with 4 months of made-up sales so you can explore. You can delete them later.
auth.session_expired_toast: Your session ended. Sign in again to keep going.

dashboard.subtitle: Here is how {business} is doing.
dashboard.chart_label: Daily sales for the last {n} days
dashboard.empty_title: No sales in this period yet
dashboard.empty_text: Record your first sale and you will see how your business moves here.
dashboard.attention_clear: All good for now. No important alerts.
dashboard.no_sales_yet: There are no sales to show yet.
dashboard.no_top_text: Once you sell, your star products show up here.

sales.title: Sales
sales.subtitle_new: Tap products to build the sale, then charge it.
sales.subtitle_history: Review what you sold and void a sale if you made a mistake.
sales.no_match_title: We could not find that product
sales.no_match_text: Check the spelling or add it from Inventory.
sales.cart_empty: Tap a product to start the sale.
sales.history_none_text: When you charge a sale, it will show up here.
sales.void_text: {total} will be removed from your sales and the products go back to inventory. This cannot be undone.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.subtitle: You have {n} products in your catalog.
inventory.none_text: Change the search or add a new product.
inventory.adjust_hint: Type the amount without a sign; under “Count or correction” use a negative number to subtract.
inventory.cost_hint: What it costs you, not what you charge.
inventory.min_hint: We warn you when stock falls below this.
inventory.track_hint: Turn it off for services or prepared dishes.
inventory.delete_text: “{name}” will disappear from your catalog. Past sales are kept.

customers.title: Customers
customers.subtitle: Who buys from you, how much and how often.
customers.none_text: Add the people who buy often to learn their habits.
customers.delete_text: “{name}” will be removed from your list. Their purchases stay in the history as walk-in sales.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.subtitle: Who you buy from and how long they take to deliver.
suppliers.none_text: Add them so the app can work out when each order makes sense.
suppliers.lead_hint: Days between placing the order and receiving it.
suppliers.no_products: You have not assigned any products yet.
suppliers.delete_text: “{name}” will be removed from your list. Their products will have no supplier.

ai.title: AI insights
ai.subtitle: What you will likely sell, what looks unusual and what to do about it.
ai.next7: Expected sales over the next 7 days
ai.accuracy_text: We tested it on your last {days} days. A simple guess is right {baseline} of the time; this method beats it.
ai.chart_label: Actual sales and forecast for the next {n} days
ai.not_enough_text: To forecast we need at least {n} days of sales. Keep recording and check back soon.
ai.reorder_text: Worked out from what you sell each day and how long each supplier takes.
ai.reorder_none_text: Your inventory covers the next few days well.
ai.anomalies_text: Sales that moved far from what was expected for that day of the week.
ai.anomalies_none_text: Your sales have behaved as expected.
ai.alerts_none_text: When something needs your attention, you will see it here.
ai.assistant_text: Google AI reads your business numbers and tells you what matters most, with concrete actions. It never sees customer names or personal data.
ai.assistant_idle: Press “Generate summary” and the AI ({model}) will prepare your analysis.
ai.generating: The AI is reading your data…
ai.assistant_off_text: The forecast and alerts already work offline. To get a written summary with actions, connect your Google Cloud account with Vertex AI.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Download your data as files that open in Excel and Google Sheets.
reports.sales_text: Every sale with date, customer, payment method and total.
reports.products_text: Units, revenue and profit for each product.
reports.inventory_text: Stock, costs and prices across your whole catalog.
reports.excel_tip: Tip: in Excel, use “Data > From Text/CSV” if accents do not display correctly.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Your account, your business and the AI connection.
settings.profile_text: This is how we see you inside the app.
settings.password_text: We ask for the current one to confirm it is you.
settings.business_text: The name appears on the dashboard and in your reports.
settings.type_hint: Changing it does not delete your products; it only adjusts how analyses are interpreted.
settings.ai_text: Upload your service account JSON key to turn on the assistant.
settings.ai_file_hint: The .json file you downloaded from Google Cloud.
settings.ai_privacy: The key is stored only on this computer and is never sent to the browser or to third parties. Only aggregated figures travel to Google.
settings.ai_remove_text: The key stored on this computer is deleted. The forecast and alerts keep working.

notFound.title: This page does not exist
notFound.text: The link may be misspelled or the section may have moved.

stockout_risk.title: {product} will run out soon
stockout_risk.body: {stock} {unit} left, enough for about {coverDays} day(s), and the order from {supplier} takes {leadDays} day(s). Place the order today.

below_minimum.title: {product} fell below the minimum
below_minimum.body: You have {stock} {unit} and the minimum you set is {minStock}. Restock so you do not miss sales.

low_rotation.title: {product} barely sells
low_rotation.body: You sold {soldLast30} {unit} in 30 days and still hold {stock}: about {idleValue} tied up. Consider a promotion or not reordering it.

weekday_peak.title: {product} sells more on {weekday}
weekday_peak.body: On those days you sell about {peakUnits} {unit}, {uplift}% more than on others. You have {stock} in stock today.

demand_up.title: {product} is selling more
demand_up.body: Up {change}% compared with previous weeks. Make sure you do not run out.

demand_down.title: {product} is selling less
demand_down.body: Down {change}% compared with previous weeks. Look at the price, where it is displayed or whether tastes changed.

low_margin.title: {product} leaves little margin
low_margin.body: Your margin is {margin}%. Review the sale price or negotiate the cost with your supplier.

anomaly_up.title: Unusual day: {date}
anomaly_up.body: You sold {pct}% more than expected for that day.
anomaly_up.body_driver: You sold {pct}% more than expected for that day. The biggest push came from {driver}.

anomaly_down.title: Slow day: {date}
anomaly_down.body: You sold {pct}% less than expected for that day.
anomaly_down.body_driver: You sold {pct}% less than expected for that day. The biggest drop was in {driver}.

auth.invalid_credentials.what: The username or password does not match.

auth.session_expired.why: It closes after a while for your security.

auth.session_missing.todo: Enter with your username and password.

auth.username_taken.todo: Try another one, for example adding your last name.

auth.too_many_attempts.what: You tried too many times in a row.
auth.too_many_attempts.why: We limit this to protect your account.
auth.too_many_attempts.todo: Wait a few minutes and try again.

auth.forbidden.what: You do not have permission to do this.
auth.forbidden.todo: Ask them to do it or to give you access.

common.not_found.what: We could not find what you were looking for.
common.not_found.todo: Go back to the dashboard and try from there.

common.unexpected.what: Something went wrong on our side.
common.unexpected.todo: Try again. If it keeps happening, close and reopen the app.

common.offline.what: There is no connection to the server.
common.offline.why: The screen cannot talk to the program that stores your data.
common.offline.todo: Check that ImpulsoPYME is still open and try again.

common.bad_payload.what: We could not read the data sent.
common.bad_payload.todo: Check the form and try again.

common.payload_too_large.what: The data sent is too large.

validation.invalid_email.what: That email does not look valid.
validation.invalid_email.todo: Check that it looks like name@domain.com.

validation.invalid_username.what: The username has characters that are not allowed.
validation.invalid_username.why: Only letters, numbers, dot and underscore are accepted.

validation.invalid_option.what: You picked an option that does not exist.

validation.invalid_id.what: We could not identify the item.
validation.invalid_id.todo: Refresh the page and try again.

stock.insufficient.what: There is not enough stock of {product}.
stock.insufficient.todo: Lower the quantity or record a stock entry first.

sales.too_many_lines.what: The sale has too many products.

sales.not_found.what: We could not find that sale.

products.not_found.what: We could not find that product.
products.not_found.todo: Refresh the inventory and try again.

customers.not_found.what: We could not find that customer.
customers.not_found.todo: Refresh the list and try again.

suppliers.not_found.what: We could not find that supplier.
suppliers.not_found.todo: Refresh the list and try again.

categories.not_found.what: We could not find that category.
categories.not_found.todo: Refresh the list and try again.

categories.duplicate.what: A category with that name already exists.

ai.not_configured.what: Google AI is not connected yet.
ai.not_configured.why: The key for your Google Cloud account is missing.
ai.not_configured.todo: Connect it in Settings > Artificial intelligence. The local forecast keeps working.

ai.invalid_key.what: That file is not a valid key.
ai.invalid_key.why: It must be the JSON of a Google Cloud service account.
ai.invalid_key.todo: Download it again from the console and retry.

ai.not_enough_data.what: There are too few sales to analyze.
ai.not_enough_data.why: At least 3 weeks of history are needed.
ai.not_enough_data.todo: Record sales for a few more days and come back.

ai.timeout.what: The AI took too long to answer.

ai.auth_failed.what: Google did not accept the credentials.
ai.auth_failed.why: The key may have expired or the account lacks the “Vertex AI User” role.
ai.auth_failed.todo: Check the role in Google Cloud or upload a new key.

ai.model_unavailable.what: The AI model is not available.
ai.model_unavailable.why: It may not be enabled in your region or project.
ai.model_unavailable.todo: Enable the Vertex AI API or change the model in the settings.

ai.quota.what: You reached the AI usage limit.
ai.quota.why: Google limits how many requests you can make per minute.
ai.quota.todo: Wait a minute and try again.

ai.unavailable.what: We could not reach the AI right now.
ai.unavailable.todo: Try again later. The local analysis is still available.
